title: Pasta with cream sauce, seafood, and added vegetables, ready‑to‑heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with cream sauce, seafood and added vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains pasta, a cream‑based sauce, a mix of seafood (shrimp, mussels, squid) and vegetables (bell pepper, broccoli, carrot).

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cream sauce is enriched with B‑vitamins and vitamin D.
Seafood provides a high level of omega‑3 fatty acids.
Vegetables are added at the end of cooking to preserve maximum nutrients.
The dish is designed for fast preparation: 3‑5 minutes in the microwave.
Pasta has a moderate glycemic index, making it more suitable for blood‑sugar control.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Seafood and pasta together deliver about 20 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Shrimp and mussels contain EPA and DHA, which promote heart and vascular health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Cream, vegetables and seafood provide vitamin D, B12, iron, zinc and magnesium.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Added vegetables contribute fiber that aids normal digestion.

items.title: Low in trans‑fats
items.content: The cream sauce is made without hydrogenated oils, making the dish healthier.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: The product contains shrimp, mussels and squid, which may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The sauce contains a moderate amount of salt; people monitoring sodium intake should consider this.

items.title: Lactose
items.content: The cream sauce contains lactose, which can be problematic for lactose‑intolerant individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: One serving provides roughly 450 kcal, so portion control is advised for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Thermal safety
items.content: Insufficiently heated product may contain live bacteria; heat to at least 75 °C before consumption.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave (≈3‑4 minutes on high) or on the stove, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately, optionally garnished with fresh herbs or grated Parmesan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at +4 °C for up to 5 days. After opening, seal the package tightly to prevent moisture. If frozen, keep for up to 2 months.
